commit.message:
Fix FlashAttention indexing demo

There was an issue with indexing, accessing illegal range of
positions for input data (from global memory) and illegal
access in private memory. The problem was detected using
a discrete GPU (e.g., an NVIDIA GPU).

Furthermore, the accumulation for m and l (max and sums),
should be for all the tiles within each GPU thread.
This PR fixes both issues, and it now passes the tests
for both OpenCL and CUDA devices.
Enable flashAttention sample in pom files
